_comment: Tripletex API reference built from sandbox exploration. Account IDs vary per company — always look up by number.

POST /employee.notes: userType: STANDARD (default) | EXTENDED (required for admin) | NO_ACCESS. department: always required — GET /department and use first result. For admin: set userType=EXTENDED then PUT /employee/entitlement/:grantEntitlementsByTemplate?employeeId=X&template=ALL_PRIVILEGES.

PUT /employee/entitlement/:grantEntitlem.notes: template=ALL_PRIVILEGES grants ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR (97 entitlements). Employee must have userType=EXTENDED first. Returns empty body — handle gracefully.

GET /employee.notes: Use GET /employee?email=X for precise lookup. GET /employee?firstName=X&lastName=Y for name search.

POST /customer.notes: isCustomer defaults to FALSE in Tripletex — ALWAYS set explicitly. country.id=161 is Norway. Use physicalAddress for physical address, postalAddress for mailing address.

GET /customer.notes: GET /customer?organizationNumber=X for org lookup (most precise). GET /customer?name=X for name search.

POST /product.notes: number must be a STRING. vatType IDs (outgoing): 3=25%, 31=15%, 32=12%, 5=0%.

POST /department.notes: moduleDepartmentAccounting may need enabling: PUT /company/modules {moduleDepartmentAccounting: true}.

POST /project.notes: startDate defaults to today if omitted. projectManager: REQUIRED. Competition pre-populates employee and customer — find by email/org number. GET /employee?email=X, GET /customer?organizationNumber=X.

POST /order.notes: deliveryDate is REQUIRED (cannot be null). Order lines: use description for free-text services. For products: use {product: {id: X}, count: 1, unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency: Y}. When productNumber is given in prompt, look up product: GET /product?number=X.

POST /invoice.notes: Must link to an order via orders list. Bank account required: call _ensure_bank_account before creating invoice. Account 1920 (Bankinnskudd) must have bankAccountNumber set: GET /ledger/account?isBankAccount=true, then PUT /ledger/account/{id} with {bankAccountNumber: '15030515002'}.

PUT /invoice/{id}/:payment.notes: paymentTypeId: GET /invoice/paymentType (use first result). paidAmount = invoice amountRemainingCurrency.

PUT /invoice/{id}/:createCreditNote.notes: Creates a credit note. date = today in YYYY-MM-DD. Returns new credit invoice id.

PUT /project/{id}.notes: To set fixed price: GET /project/{id}?fields=*, set isFixedPrice=true and fixedprice=X, then PUT with full object.

POST /travelExpense.notes: travelDetails.departureDate in YYYY-MM-DD. No 'description' field on travelExpense root object.

POST /ledger/voucher.notes: Supplier invoice voucher: debit expense account (7100 etc), debit input VAT (2710=25%, 2711=15%, 2712=12%), credit payables (2400). Positive = debit, negative = credit. ALWAYS look up account IDs by number: GET /ledger/account?number=7100.

standard_accounts.1920: Bankinnskudd (bank account — needs bankAccountNumber set for invoicing)
standard_accounts.2400: Leverandørgjeld (accounts payable — credit in supplier invoice voucher)
standard_accounts.2710: Inngående merverdiavgift, høy sats 25% (input VAT debit)
standard_accounts.2711: Inngående merverdiavgift, middels sats 15% (input VAT debit)
standard_accounts.2712: Inngående merverdiavgift, lav sats 12% (input VAT debit)
standard_accounts.7100: Bilgodtgjørelse oppgavepliktig (car allowance — often used in competition as general expense)

create_invoice: 1. Ensure bank account: GET /ledger/account?isBankAccount=true → PUT /ledger/account/{id} if no bankAccountNumber
3. Lookup products if productNumbers in orderLines: GET /product?number=X
create_invoice_with_payment: 3. Lookup products by number if specified
register_supplier_invoice: 1. Compute net = incl/(1+vat%), vat = incl - net

create_customer.notes: Address fields are checked — always extract from prompt

create_product.notes: vatPercentage in prompt → resolve to vatType id

notes: No bank account pre-set → invoice 422 (works on competition accounts after _ensure_bank_account)
Employee emails persist across runs → duplicate 422 on repeat tests (use unique emails)
